method.numerical_floor: max(|baseline residual|, max |phase/scale gauge residual|, 64*float64_epsilon*max(1,|baseline lhs|,|baseline rhs|))
method.numerical_floor_status: Declared empirical/roundoff scale, not a rigorous error bound
method.slope: OLS log(raw positive residual) against log(epsilon), using only resolved epsilon in [1e-4,1e-2] and requiring at least two points
method.quantitative_lower_bound: R >= beta*eta/(2*U0*U1) * ||XX*-YY*||_1^2, in nats, where U0=alpha+beta and U1=eta+delta; use zero bound if U0*U1=0
method.quantitative_bound_provenance: Derived corollary from the pinned thermal mixture inequality plus quantum Pinsker; analytic proof and review are separate from this numerical calculation
method.trace_norm_evaluation: Sum absolute eigenvalues of the Hermitian Gram difference
method.bound_ratio_rule: Report residual/bound and bound/residual only when bound>10*numerical_floor; bound/residual additionally requires positive resolved residual
method.generic_tangent_gram_derivative: D=HX*+XH*; ||D||_1 is recorded per generic complex-HS-orthogonal tangent path
